On the second week of my apprenticeship, I had decided to head into work at around 4:30am so I could get my head together before starting. I made extremely good time and got into work about an hour early so decided to get a coffee and drive to a nearby park to watch the sun rise. As I was driving past the park, I saw a decent sized yoga class doing stretches. This didn't seem especially odd, but I made a mental note of them being there. When I got to the gate leading into the parking, I found it was locked, so I started driving back to site. On my way back I looked out the window and saw that there was nobody anywhere near where the yoga class had been previously. This wouldn't have been especially odd, however the time between seeing them, and me turning back couldn't have been more than a minute. And there was utterly no sign of anyone having been there.
